{{Quote|You ever need a hive extraction team or a couple tonnes of xenotoxic torpedoes, you give the Bughunters a call.|Sergeant Namada|<ref name="Mission">{{TORcite|type=faction|Imperial|Lethal Attraction|[[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]]}}</ref>}}
A '''xenotoxic torpedo''' was a type of toxin-bearing [[Missile/Legends|missile]] that was used against [[Alien/Legends|alien]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. [[Special Tactics Group 41-Delta]], also known as Bughunter Division, used xenotoxic torpedoes in their work.
